title: PaymentFailed v1
description: Payment tells that one payment attempt failed and no money was taken: the provider declined it, or confirmed that it holds no charge. A timeout alone is never reported as a failure (ADR-0006, rule R5). Routing key: payment.payment-failed. Sent once per payment. It carries identifiers, the amount and a reason code only: no card data, no personal data. Consumers ignore unknown fields (ADR-0009, part F).

eventId.description: ID of this message, used by consumers to recognize duplicates

correlationId.description: Null today: the payment processor is not a request

aggregateId.description: The payment; the same as data.paymentId

bookingId.description: The booking the payment is for

attemptNumber.description: Which attempt for this booking; with bookingId it is the idempotency key of the attempt

amountMinor.description: The amount in the smallest unit of the currency

reason.description: Why it failed. A consumer must treat a code it does not know as an unspecified failure.
